title: Generic early-warning statistics
hypothesis: Rolling variance, lag-one autocorrelation and skew can diagnose critical slowing while remaining non-directional features.
causalBoundary: Every statistic at t is computed from a trailing preregistered window that ends at t; no centered or future window is allowed.
counterfactual: Time-shuffled stationary inputs should remove persistent autocorrelation structure while preserving marginal observations.
